content_data.meeting_title: Visual Identity & Asset Optimization for Cost Reduction Initiative
agenda_items: Align on key visual KPIs for cost-reduction success
Discuss impact of proposed design changes on user experience and brand perception
Review current visual assets and identify areas for consolidation/simplification
Brainstorm creative solutions for reducing asset production costs without compromising brand quality
Outline next steps for design-led cost-saving proposals
key_decisions: Standardize UI element libraries to minimize design variations and development overhead.
Prioritize repurposing existing high-quality assets over creating new ones for initial phases.
action_items: Art Director: Schedule a workshop with 3D artists to explore procedural generation tools within the next two weeks.
Marketing Lead: Prepare a brief on brand guidelines and non-negotiable visual elements for the cost reduction initiative by end of week.

memory_deletes.removed_item: Product Manager: Provide data on player engagement with current visual assets to inform design decisions within the next 5 days.
Conduct A/B testing on simplified visual elements to gauge player reception before full implementation.
Creative Designer (Persona): Develop a concept presentation showcasing proposed visual asset consolidation strategies by next week.
Investigate procedural generation techniques for certain in-game assets to reduce manual labor.
